about: NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entry 264: the donor pack, one sheet of each style, Letter first and A4 beside it where the library has one. Each PDF is the sheet and its one page of instructions, made by `grouplab donor-pack` from the library; DonorPackTests fails when a committed PDF no longer matches what the library makes, and the site's publish runs those tests first. The site build zips the PDFs into the whole pack.
mostUseful: The C3 zeroing grids, which GroupLab has no real photographs of yet, and the E and C bulls, which it has seen from one range day only.

sheets.name: The E bull, 5x5
sheets.use: The everyday sheet for load development through a scope: a black disc with a white center and a small dot, 25 bulls and three sighters.

sheets.name: The C bull, 5x5
sheets.use: The same sheet with a diamond standing on its point, whose points sit on a crosshair's lines.

sheets.name: 5x5 with a load block
sheets.use: The E bull sheet with a block to write the load in, for a range day with several loads.

sheets.name: Zeroing grid, MOA at 100 yd
sheets.use: Zeroing a scope with quarter-MOA clicks at 100 yards: shoot a group at the diamond and read the correction off the grid.

sheets.name: Zeroing grid, mil at 100 yd
sheets.use: The same for a scope with 0.1 mil clicks.

sheets.use: Zeroing with quarter-MOA clicks at 100 meters.
